notes.title: Patch Notes v1.04
notes.content:
[b]Quality of life patches[/b]

- Added Joystick input to menus.
- Added right and left bumper as district swap buttons on level menu.
- Added 'S' key as fast forward button for grading sequence.
  [i]- Y / Triangle button on gamepads.[/i]
- Added tutorial in 7-3 about gravity arrows disabling the float form.
- Added vSync option to settings menu.
- Added detail toggle option to settings menu; disables frame-rate intensive area backgrounds.

[b]- Game now runs at 60fps on Windows 10 systems.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.02
notes.content:
[b]Minor bug hotfix.[/b]

- Fixed motion sensors not detecting WASD input.
- Redesigned 16-6 to be consistently beatable on all framerates.
- Fixed event trigger bug in 24-4.
- Nerfed Area 6 time requirements to make achieving S rank easier.
- Moved restart tutorial from Area 16 to Area 1.
